_note: ILLUSTRATIVE go/no-go criteria for the decision summary (task A-12; plan section 8, item 5; architecture-overview (d): scope fit, deviations against past bids, engineering checks, capacity and timeline conflicts, open questions). Thresholds are PLACEHOLDERS to be agreed with the bid manager. Layer 0 gives advice; a named person decides.

criteria.name: Scope fit
criteria.question: Do the suggested units fit the RFP's scope (no unit outside the layers the RFP covers)?

criteria.name: Every requirement routed
criteria.question: Does every frozen requirement have a match (a unit, or the bid desk)?

criteria.name: Coverage
criteria.question: Are enough product requirements fully or partly satisfied (at least the coverage threshold)?

criteria.name: Open questions
criteria.question: Are there no open questions (rule warnings, unanchored requirements)?

criteria.name: Matches reviewed
criteria.question: Has a person accepted or changed every product match?

criteria.name: No pending-acquisition dependency
criteria.question: Does nothing depend on a unit whose acquisition has not closed (EPC Power)?

criteria.name: Deviations against past bids
criteria.question: How does this RFP deviate from past bids we won or lost?

criteria.name: Capacity and portfolio conflicts
criteria.question: Do the units have capacity, given their other opportunities (task A-10)?

criteria.name: Cost against budget
criteria.question: Is the product cost within the customer's budget and our margin target?

criteria.name: Delivery against the RFP schedule
criteria.question: Can we deliver by the dates the RFP asks for?

criteria.name: Competitor information
criteria.question: Who else is bidding and how do we compare?
